scientific_integrity: All-parameter homotopy conclusions follow from exact facet classification, symbolic seven-column locality and elementary free-face pairs; finite mod-two computations corroborate small and large instances but are not an infinite proof. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite prism-graph vertex metrics, integer scale two, and the scale-one-to-two first-homology map only; no higher scales, continuous edge interiors, or unequal ladders. The cube case n=4 is previously known. Indexed-source comparison cannot exclude unindexed equivalent work.
title: Scale-two Rips homotopy types of finite circular ladders
